content:
Among the many new products Apple is launching this fall is the Apple Watch Series 12. Here are the four rumored new features coming to this year's Apple Watch update.

#1: All-New Chip (A Real Upgrade)

The Apple Watch Series 9, 10, and 11 all essentially use the same chip. However, this year's Apple Watch Series 12 is rumored to receive a true chip upgrade.

Macworld reported on the change:

The 2026 model is labeled "Watch8," which suggests a major hardware leap. For example, the Apple Watch Series 9, Series 10, and Series 11 were all grouped into the "Watch7" series due to their similar specifications. As for the "Watch8" series, it includes models N237, N238, and N240 (namely, the GPS and cellular versions of the Apple Watch Series 12, as well as the Ultra 4), all equipped with the new T8320 processor.

The last time Apple introduced a truly new processor for the Apple Watch was with the Apple Watch Series 9 back in 2023. That upgrade delivered faster CPU and GPU performance.

As Apple brings Siri AI features to the Apple Watch through watchOS 27, improved performance will be key for future AI capabilities.

#2: Battery Life

Battery life is reportedly one of the key improvements for this year's Apple Watch Series 12. Apple is said to be working on increasing the device's physical battery capacity, along with boosting energy efficiency in other areas.

Extending battery life is a major priority for the company as Apple continues to add features like sleep tracking to the Apple Watch.

#3: All-New Health Features

According to Digitimes, Apple has submitted a brand-new hypertension notification feature to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for review.

watchOS 26 brought hypertension notifications to the Apple Watch for the first time. It remains unclear how this rumored new hypertension feature will differ from the existing version.

The current Apple Watch hypertension feature does not actually provide specific blood pressure readings. Instead, it uses data collected by the Apple Watch heart rate sensor to notify users when a "hypertension pattern" is detected over a 30-day assessment period.

Whether the Apple Watch Series 12 will bring other health feature upgrades remains unknown. Apple is still working on a non-invasive blood glucose monitoring feature for the Apple Watch, but that capability is still years away from an official launch.

#4: All-New Watch Face

According to Bloomberg, Apple is developing a brand-new Apple Watch face that is a "simplified version of the Modular Ultra design."

This essentially adapts the popular Modular Ultra face from the Apple Watch Ultra into a version suited to the standard "Series" watches.

This new modular face is expected to gradually support other Apple Watch models, but we anticipate it will be officially unveiled at the Apple Watch Series 12 launch event.

Extra News: What Not to Expect

Although earlier rumors suggested the Apple Watch Series 12 might add Touch ID support, it appears that this feature will not be coming.

Newer rumors instead indicate that Apple decided to drop the feature after evaluation, as new health features and a larger-capacity battery are more important for the Apple Watch.

Apple Watch Series 12 New Features: Summary

The Apple Watch Series 12 is expected to be announced in September alongside the Apple Watch Ultra 4.

Which new Apple Watch feature are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments below.
